sources.snippet: Robust AI Detection. RAID is the largest & most comprehensive dataset for evaluating AI-generated text detectors. It contains over 10 million documents spanning 11 LLMs, 11 genres, 4 decoding strategies, and 12 adversarial attacks. It is designed to be the go-to location for trustworthy third-party evaluation of popular detectors.
